zoneLooks.name: THE ALTAR

canon.name: STONE
canon.idea: The wall is the weapon. Pillars, corners and stub walls: a man knocked into any of them stays down. A man knocked onto open floor gets up.

zoneLooks.theme: The cult's inner sanctum, the altar the sacrifice never reached.

zoneLooks.name: THE YARD

canon.name: FIRE
canon.idea: Coals and straw. Every room has something in it that burns, and by the time the mage lights the ground you have already lit it yourself.

zoneLooks.theme: The yard behind the sanctum, kept lit for the rendering to come.

zoneLooks.name: THE CAVE

canon.name: THE HOLLOW
canon.idea: No wall runs straight. The rock curves, so a man thrown along it slides; he dies on what he hits square, a boulder, the end of a bend. The grass hides whoever is in it, and that includes you.

zoneLooks.theme: The caves the compound was dug out of, where nobody bothered to square the walls.

zoneLooks.name: THE ROAD

canon.name: THE LINE
canon.idea: Long sightlines and hard cover. A rifle owns whatever it can see, so the room is about what it cannot, and about crossing the rest.

zoneLooks.theme: The processional road out of the compound, watched the whole way by rifles.

zoneLooks.name: THE FOUNDRY

canon.name: IRON
canon.idea: The cult builds what it cannot breed. Presses, belts and burners in every room, and the machines walking them do not bleed.

zoneLooks.theme: The works under the compound, where the cult builds what it cannot breed.

zoneLooks.name: THE ENGINE

canon.name: IRON
canon.idea: The cult builds what it cannot breed. Presses, belts and burners in every room, and the machines walking them do not bleed.

zoneLooks.theme: The engine that drives the works, hot, loud and built to crush.

zoneLooks.name: THE RAFTERS

canon.name: THE DROP
canon.idea: The floor is not all there. Holes in the boards and windows in the walls, the same fall under both, and nobody who goes over comes back.

zoneLooks.theme: The rafters over the great hall, where the roof itself has started to give.

zoneLooks.name: THE OSSUARY

canon.name: THE NICHE
canon.idea: A body cannot form inside stone. Niches and lanes take arcs away from the dead; the open floor between them gives every arc back.

zoneLooks.theme: The ossuary beneath the compound, where nothing it ever killed stayed put.

zoneLooks.name: THE DARK

canon.name: THE LAMP
canon.idea: Every room has its lamp, and the lamp is a choice: it shows them to you and you to them. Knock it down and it burns where it falls, and then the room is black and they hunt you by ear.

zoneLooks.theme: The cellars under the yard, where the cult keeps what it does not want seen.

canon.name: IRON
canon.idea: Plate floors, presses and belts. The cult's machines, with meat in them.

zoneLooks.theme: The works under the compound, where the cult builds what it cannot breed.

zoneDefs.name: THE ALTAR

canon.name: STONE
canon.idea: The wall is the weapon. Pillars, corners and stub walls: a man knocked into any of them stays down. A man knocked onto open floor gets up.

zoneDefs.theme: The cult's inner sanctum, the altar the sacrifice never reached.
zoneDefs.decor: Bare stone: pillars, corners, stub walls, straw in the pen, one stand of arms, the Mill.

zoneDefs.name: THE YARD

canon.name: FIRE
canon.idea: Coals and straw. Every room has something in it that burns, and by the time the mage lights the ground you have already lit it yourself.

zoneDefs.theme: The yard behind the sanctum, kept lit for the rendering to come.
zoneDefs.decor: Braziers, straw, ovens, oil lamps, a hound pack, the Seer’s witchfire.
zoneDefs.hint: THE MAGE BURNS THE GROUND YOU STAND ON

zoneDefs.name: THE CAVE

canon.name: THE HOLLOW
canon.idea: No wall runs straight. The rock curves, so a man thrown along it slides; he dies on what he hits square, a boulder, the end of a bend. The grass hides whoever is in it, and that includes you.

zoneDefs.theme: The caves the compound was dug out of, where nobody bothered to square the walls.
zoneDefs.decor: Round rock, tall grass that hides, boulders that break, hounds and a garrison in the dark.
zoneDefs.hint: THE GRASS HIDES YOU. IT HIDES THEM TOO. THE ROCK HAS TEETH.

zoneDefs.name: THE ROAD

canon.name: THE LINE
canon.idea: Long sightlines and hard cover. A rifle owns whatever it can see, so the room is about what it cannot, and about crossing the rest.

zoneDefs.theme: The processional road out of the compound, watched the whole way by rifles.
zoneDefs.decor: Colonnades, long naves, stub cover, a killbox, grating underfoot, the Great Hall.
zoneDefs.hint: PUT SOMETHING SOLID BETWEEN YOU AND THE LINE. WATCH YOUR STEP.

zoneDefs.name: THE FOUNDRY

canon.name: IRON
canon.idea: The cult builds what it cannot breed. Presses, belts and burners in every room, and the machines walking them do not bleed.

zoneDefs.theme: The works under the compound, where the cult builds what it cannot breed.
zoneDefs.decor: Riveted plate, grating, boilers, belts, the welders' torches.
zoneDefs.hint: THE MACHINES DO NOT BLEED. THE PRESS DOES NOT CARE WHO IS IN IT.

zoneDefs.name: THE ENGINE

canon.name: IRON
canon.idea: The cult builds what it cannot breed. Presses, belts and burners in every room, and the machines walking them do not bleed.

zoneDefs.theme: The engine that drives the works, hot, loud and built to crush.
zoneDefs.decor: Burner grills, flame pipes, gantries over the drop, the shield generators' domes.
zoneDefs.hint: BREAK THE DOME FIRST. EVERYTHING HERE BURNS BUT THEM.

zoneDefs.name: THE RAFTERS

canon.name: THE DROP
canon.idea: The floor is not all there. Holes in the boards and windows in the walls, the same fall under both, and nobody who goes over comes back.

zoneDefs.theme: The rafters over the great hall, where the roof itself has started to give.
zoneDefs.decor: Holes in the boards, windows in the walls, narrow catwalks, the same fall under both.
zoneDefs.hint: THE FLOOR ENDS. THEY FALL FURTHER THAN YOU.

zoneDefs.name: THE OSSUARY

canon.name: THE NICHE
canon.idea: A body cannot form inside stone. Niches and lanes take arcs away from the dead; the open floor between them gives every arc back.

zoneDefs.theme: The ossuary beneath the compound, where nothing it ever killed stayed put.
zoneDefs.decor: Stone niches and lanes, open floor between them, wraiths arriving from behind.
zoneDefs.hint: IT CANNOT STOP ONCE IT STARTS. LET IT START.

zoneDefs.name: THE DARK

canon.name: THE LAMP
canon.idea: Every room has its lamp, and the lamp is a choice: it shows them to you and you to them. Knock it down and it burns where it falls, and then the room is black and they hunt you by ear.

zoneDefs.theme: The cellars under the yard, where the cult keeps what it does not want seen.
zoneDefs.decor: Low vaults and cells, a standing lamp or two to a room, a lantern on the wall by every door, and nothing else lit.
zoneDefs.hint: A LAMP SHOWS THEM TO YOU, AND YOU TO THEM. KNOCK IT DOWN: IT BURNS, AND THEN THE ROOM IS BLACK.
